description: Insert a single block of a given type into the editor. Default mode types the slash inserter on screen (visible in recordings); programmatic mode inserts silently via the JS API. By default, blocks are appended at the end of the document; set afterBlockType+afterBlockIndex (zero-based, of that type) to insert after a specific existing block. If the user said "random text", set randomLength to short/medium/long and leave content empty — the server fills it with lorem-ipsum content. Otherwise, if content is omitted the server fills an indexed placeholder ("Paragraph 1", "Heading 1", ...) the user can edit inline.
examples: add a paragraph that says Welcome to the site
insert a paragraph with random text
add a paragraph with short random text
insert a paragraph with long random text
insert a paragraph after the second paragraph
add a heading after the first paragraph
